source.title: Architect of the Capitol - House Historic Buildings Revitalization Trust Fund (Program and Financing)

unit_note: USD millions. AoC House Historic Buildings Revitalization Trust Fund (id 001-1833-0-1-801): P&F on PDF page 11 (printed 23) left column. Receives transfers from House Office Buildings (unit #119): unobligated balance transfers (1011 unobligated balance transfer from HOB's 1010 line) and appropriation transfers (1121 appropriations transferred from HOB's 1120 line). 1070 is multi-source in c1/c2 (1000+1011) but single-source in c3. 1930 c2/c3 is multi-source (1070+4000). Change in obligated balance: 3050 c1 is two-source (3000+3020; no 3010 new obligations row prints), while c2/c3 are three-source (3000+3010+3020). Negatives as printed (3020).
